title: Subjects
why: Grouping samples by subject — patient, animal, culture, slide — keeps two samples from the same person out of different training splits, where the metric would measure memory instead of generalization.
patternHelp: Use {{marca}} where the identifier is and * for the rest. Example: {{ejemplo}} extracts P0031 from P0031_ax_012.jpg
unmatchedStay: Files that do not match stay unassigned: they never get a guessed subject.
csvHelp: Two-column file: filename and subject, separated by comma, semicolon or tab.
mapUnused: {{count}} rows in the file match no image in this project.
privacy: The subject is exported and travels with the project. If you load a real clinical identifier, pseudonymising it is your responsibility.
